consequence.statement: The release note (listed under 'Other (Cleanup or Flake)') states only that the vendored third_party/forked/acme package is patched to support the ACME profiles extension; it reports no failure, rejection, ignored setting, lost permission, or required operator action.

original.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 patches the vendored third_party/forked/acme package to add support for the ACME profiles extension; the release note (under 'Other (Cleanup or Flake)') states no operator-visible effect or required action.

decision.reason: [ev-8ec1fdd0d15f] lists this under 'Other (Cleanup or Flake)'. It says only that the internal third_party/forked/acme package was patched to add support for the ACME profiles extension. Nothing in it describes a failure, a rejection, an ignored setting, lost access or a required step, so an operator who does nothing is not affected and 'none' (informational) fits. Confidence is low because the note never says outright that there is no operator impact; that conclusion comes from the change only adding support and being filed as cleanup.
